title: Operator voice profile
description: ADR-0083 (C3): the operator's measured voice as rule lines in the manuscript language, derived from their own published chapters (docs/10-corpus). A policy names a profile (identity.voice_profile); at novel start its lines are copied into the project's composed identity (preferences.operator_voice), so a project reads frozen bytes. Writers and editors read `writer`, planners `planner`, judges `judges` (the operator's conventions that are not defects). Versions are immutable.

evidence.description: Where the numbers and conventions come from (documents, corpus scope).
